Compare Z1-only relative spectra after the declared observed-origin/calculated-0-0 alignment. No absolute-origin accuracy, all-peak agreement, or fixed software mode number is required. Identify the physical in-plane-bending mode by displacement/FC evidence. Honest disagreement can earn evidence/process credit but is not automatically reproduction of the reference result; never fabricate experimental matches.
